title: The 7 Best Vibe Coding Platforms in 2026: Full-Stack Compared
summary: Best vibe coding platforms compared by full-stack completeness, production readiness, and pricing. Which one ships real apps, not just demos? 2026.
body_markdown: Pricing at scale varies significantly. Blink charges based on your plan tier, not per-user or per-request, so a growing user base does not directly spike your platform bill. Lovable charges per-credit for AI generation, not for active users — your cost scales with how much you build, not how many people use it. Replit charges for compute time on hosted repls. Cursor Pro is per-seat for the developer building the app, regardless of end-user count. The platforms with the most predictable cost at scale are the ones that charge for creation rather than consumption: Blink, Lovable (for the app-running side), and Base44.
